subject: Evaluation seed exchange & constrained license — MAP and close timeline
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmerobotics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmerobotics.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot data for eval — next steps

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We validated the inference latency on our edge use case and are ready to move forward with a scoped evaluation. We can provision a 10k-row anonymized activity sample (CSV) and a small subset of our prompt library for you to run local quality checks. Before we transfer anything, security asks for a short MAP and a constrained license that limits use to the evaluation only and requires deletion after 60 days. Procurement will also need a clear close timeline to secure a PO.

Can you send a MAP draft and the usage constraints we typically require for seed set exchanges? We want to close the evaluation agreement and have the materials by Jan 22 if possible.

Best,
Emma
Emma Jones
Head of Data — Acme Robotics
[attachment: sample_manifest.txt (text)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot data for eval — next steps

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a brief MAP outline and our standard constrained-eval license language for seed material. High level:

- Exchange: Acme provides anonymized seedset (10k rows) and prompt pack. Redwood provides a time-limited evaluation environment and will return metrics and a short QA report.
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only, no model training/weights retention, delete all derived files and cached KV after 60 days, access restricted to named Redwood engineer pool.
- Security controls requested: audit logs, ephemeral credentials, and confirmation of encryption-at-rest on your side before transfer.
- Milestones / close timeline: sign MAP + DUA by Jan 18, transfer data Jan 19, evaluation complete and acceptance email by Jan 30.

I attached MAP_acme_v1.docx and a proposed_license_terms.txt. Ben — I’ll hand over the seed transfer and prompt pack once legal ACKs the DUA redline. Karthik — if you can take point on the few license tweaks Emma mentioned, that would help keep to the timeline.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_acme_v1.docx (docx)] [attachment: proposed_license_terms.txt (text)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation seed exchange & constrained license — MAP and close timeline

Emma — attaching the seed sample and the prompt pack we'll use for the automated test harness. These are sanitized slices (column-level masking + hash ids). Quick notes on usage:

- Acceptable: local quality testing, metric collection (precision/recall, hallucination rate), and feedback to Acme for prompt improvements.
- Prohibited: model training, external benchmarking sharing, or incorporating seeds into any production models.
- Retention: Redwood will purge raw seed rows and derived vectors after 60 days of receipt; temporary caches may exist for up to 7 days during active evaluation runs.

Attachments: acme_seedset_v1_sample.csv (CSV, 10k sample), acme_promptpack_v1.pdf (prompt examples + expected outputs).

If this looks good, we can initiate transfer via the secure file share. Laura — can you confirm the S3 bucket settings and logging for the transfer?

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[attachment: acme_seedset_v1_sample.csv (csv)] [attachment: acme_promptpack_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmerobotics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmerobotics.com>, procurement@acmerobotics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation seed exchange & constrained license — MAP and close timeline

Ben / Evelyn,

Thanks for the sample and constraints. A couple of security items to confirm before we sign:

1) Auditability: We need per-file access logs and proof of deletion (S3 object lifecycle + deletion receipts) when purge occurs.
2) No persistent KV cache beyond 7 days — any cached KV in the runtime must be flushed and a flush receipt provided.
3) If Redwood needs to lift the 60d deletion for troubleshooting, we require written approval from Acme with a timestamped DocuSign.

We redlined the DUA in the attached PDF. Please review the redlines inline and confirm acceptance or counter-propose. Procurement flagged PO issuance on Jan 28 contingent on signed DUA.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Security Engineer — Acme Robotics
[attachment: redline_data_use_NDA.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmerobotics.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation seed exchange & constrained license — MAP and close timeline

Daniel / Emma — thanks for the clear redlines. We've reviewed and accept the audit and deletion receipts language; have a small ask on the DocuSign exception flow to include a 3-business-day notice window for troubleshooting.

Attached: redline response and an updated MAP with explicit milestone dates that align with Procurement. Key updates:
- MAP milestone dates: Sign DUA by Jan 19 (we can accelerate if DocuSign goes today), data transfer Jan 20, evaluation window Jan 20–Jan 28, acceptance/metrics due Jan 30.
- Ownership & use: retained as evaluation-only; explicit non-training clause included.

If Acme confirms the dates today we can start the secure transfer tomorrow morning and push for PO before Jan 28.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Commercial — Redwood Inference
[attachment: redline_response_to_acme.pdf (pdf)] [attachment: MAP_acme_v1.docx (docx)]

Karthik / team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Acme accepts the updated MAP and the small DocuSign notice window. Procurement will route the PO (internal target Jan 27) once the DUA is in DocuSign. We confirm: data transfer Jan 20, evaluation window Jan 20–28, acceptance by Jan 30.

Please proceed with the secure transfer and send the DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks — looking forward to the QA report.

Emma
